LibRaw 0.22.2 — vendored source for the H2W Photo Lab RAW program (Phase 1).
Upstream: https://www.libraw.org/data/LibRaw-0.22.2.tar.gz
Tarball SHA256: de86b035655accff8d4010f1a221fdf50d353cb7b1422ba26f14a0db92612cfa
Vendored 2026-10-17. Subset: src/ libraw/ internal/ + license files only
(samples, docs, RawSpeed, GoPro extras excluded — not needed for the build).

LICENSE: dual LGPL-2.1 / CDDL-1.0. The app links LibRaw DYNAMICALLY
(libraw.so inside the APK), which keeps the LGPL route clean.
COMPLIANCE TODO (before publishing anywhere beyond the private Drive link):
ship a THIRD_PARTY note offering this exact tarball + any patches, per
LGPL-2.1 section 6. The build here applies NO patches to upstream sources.

Build notes: compiled with the EXPLICIT upstream source list from
Makefile.am (lib_libraw_a_SOURCES), NOT globbing — globbing pulls in
overlapping implementations and causes duplicate-symbol link errors.
Defines: LIBRAW_NOTHREADS (upstream autotools default), USE_ZLIB (NDK libz —
required for DEFLATE-compressed DNG tiles). NOT defined: USE_JPEG (NDK has no
libjpeg; lossy-JPEG DNGs fall back to the embedded preview per the roadmap),
USE_RAWSPEED, USE_DNGSDK.
